select * from TRUNCATE TABLE DW.DimCustomer

select customerid,SourceSystemCode, count(1) from DW.DimCustomer --WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'sec' 
group by CustomerID , SourceSystemCode having count(1)>1
order by 3 desc

select * from dw.dimcustomer where customerid = 'R01291833'

SELECT DISTINCT FinancialInstitutionId FROM  BNKM.CustomerConsent -- added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys, added filter periodenddate = null
SELECT DISTINCT ConsentId,ConsentName,* FROM BNKM.Consent
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,CustomerActionTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAction --added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys,
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' --added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys,added filter PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' CRM
SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = '1' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL --added filter PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL  CCD
SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = 'Home' AND SourceCode = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL  -- ADDED FILTER SOURCECODE = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL CCD
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' --crm added filter PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000',added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys
SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN where SourceCode = 'CCD' AND TelephoneNumberTypeId = 'Mobile Number' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL --removed join table ccd, added filter PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL CCCD
SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN WHERE TelephoneNumberTypeId = 'Cellphone Number' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL --removed join table SEC, added filter PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL  SEC
SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationZipCode,CountryId ,LocationCity,LocationStateId,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM BNKM.Location --added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys CRM
SELECT CustomerId,EmailTypeId,EmailAddress,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' --added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys,added filter PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' CRM

SELECT CustomerId,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),EmployerId,1) EmployerId,JobTitleId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL  -- added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys, added filter periodenddate = null, added convert to varchar to employerid field  CRM
 (SELECT row_number() over(partition by customerid,FinancialInstitutionId order by customerid,JobTitleId) rn, CustomerId,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),EmployerId,1) EmployerId,JobTitleId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCEMP.RN = 1 -- add row number to get top1 order by jobtitleid

SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Employer -- added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys CRM
SELECT JobTitleId,JobTitleName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.JobTitle --added FinancialInstitutionId in join keys CRM

SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE WHERE EmailTypeId = 'Primary' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL -- remove joint tabl ccd,added filter PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUSTOMERID ORDER BY CustomerAccountOpenedDate DESC) RN, * FROM (
                SELECT BCAP.CustomerId,BCARD.CustomerAccountId,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId  FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount) BCARD ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCARD.CustomerAccountId 
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountOpenedDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
				WHERE SourceSystemCode  ='SEC' ) BCAP --ADDED SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'SEC'

SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE WHERE SourceCode = 'SEC' AND EmailTypeId = 'Primary' -- updated bnkm customer email SEC, remove join table. added filter EmailTypeId = 'Primary'
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty where PeriodEndTimestamp is null  -- added fitler  PeriodEndTimestamp is null  
select * from BNKM.CustomerType 				
select * from BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL -- added filter PeriodEndDate IS NULL
select * from BNKM.MaritalStatus
select * from BNKM.Gender
SELECT * FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer where PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL --ADDED FILTER PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'MBK'
SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'RIB'
select * from BNKM.AnzsicClass
select * from BNKM.Sector
